title: Getting Around the City
text:
Many people travel by bus or train. Trains are fast and comfortable. My friend takes the train to work every day. The station is near her house.

Some people like to travel by bike. Bikes are cheap and good for the environment. My brother rides his bike to school. He has a red helmet.

questions.text: How does my friend travel to work?
What can we infer about the brother?
options: He cares about his safety when he rides
He does not want to go to school
He does not like to travel
He lives in a different country

questions.text: What is probably true about the friend?
options: She lives close to the station

vocabulary.definition: feeling good and relaxed, without pain or problems
the natural world around us, such as air, water and land
a place where trains or buses stop so people can get on or off
a hard hat that protects your head

paragraph_translations: Wiele osób podróżuje autobusem lub pociągiem. Pociągi są szybkie i wygodne. Moja przyjaciółka codziennie jeździ pociągiem do pracy. Stacja jest blisko jej domu.
Niektórzy lubią podróżować rowerem. Rowery są tanie i dobre dla środowiska. Mój brat jeździ rowerem do szkoły. Ma czerwony kask.
